formats.key: deposit(uint256 id, (address token0, address token1, bytes32 config) poolKey, int32 tickLower, int32 tickUpper, uint128 maxAmount0, uint128 maxAmount1, uint128 minLiquidity)
effects: The signer pays up to maxAmount0 of token0 and up to maxAmount1 of token1; the contract pulls them with transferFrom from the signer to the Ekubo Core accountant.
When token0 is the native token (address(0)), amount0 is paid from the ETH the signer sends as msg.value; any ETH above amount0 stays in the contract and anyone can take it with refundNativeToken.
The liquidity of position id in the given tick range grows by at least minLiquidity; the position belongs to whoever owns NFT id, which can be another owner when the signer is only approved.
The call reverts if the liquidity is below minLiquidity or the amounts exceed the maximums.
formats.shown: "Add Ve33 liquidity" with the position ID, the maximum of each token with its token, raw minimum liquidity, raw ticks and the pool tokens; the native value sent is not shown.

findings.title: deposit is payable and spends msg.value for a native token0, but no @.value field exists
findings.evidence: Ve33Positions.deposit is `public payable`; handleLockData: `if (amount0 != 0) SafeTransferLib.safeTransferETH(address(ACCOUNTANT), amount0);` pays from contract balance. PayableMulticallable.refundNativeToken sends `address(this).balance` to any msg.sender. The descriptor deposit format has no `@.value` field.

findings.title: deposit shows maxAmount0 for token0 = address(0) without nativeCurrencyAddress
findings.evidence: constants.sol: `address constant NATIVE_TOKEN_ADDRESS = address(0);` handleLockData branches on `poolKey.token0 != NATIVE_TOKEN_ADDRESS`. Descriptor field maxAmount0: `"params":{"tokenPath":"poolKey.token0"}` with no nativeCurrencyAddress.

findings.title: deposit interpolatedIntent omits the token amounts and the position shown in the fields
findings.evidence: Descriptor: `"interpolatedIntent": "Add Ve33 liquidity"` while maxAmount0 and maxAmount1 are tokenAmount fields.
findings.fix: Change interpolatedIntent to "Add up to {maxAmount0} and {maxAmount1} to position {id}".

findings.title: deposit shows minimum liquidity and ticks as raw integers with no unit
findings.evidence: Descriptor fields minLiquidity, tickLower, tickUpper use `"format":"raw"`; maxLiquidity() in Ve33Positions.handleLockData derives liquidity from sqrt ratios.

effects: The signer removes `liquidity` from position id in the tick range.
The signer receives the token0 and token1 principal that this liquidity is worth at the current pool price; there is no minimum amount.
Native value sent stays in the contract and anyone can take it with refundNativeToken.
formats.shown: "Withdraw {liquidity}" with a raw liquidity number, the position ID, raw ticks and the pool tokens; no amounts out and no native value.

findings.title: withdraw is payable but has no @.value field; sent ETH stays claimable by anyone
findings.evidence: Ve33Positions.withdraw(5 args) is `external payable`; refundNativeToken sends `address(this).balance` to msg.sender. No `@.value` field in the format.

findings.fix: Change intent to "Burn position NFT (withdraw liquidity first)".

formats.key: multicall(bytes[] data)
effects: Each data element runs as a delegatecall into this contract with the signer as msg.sender: deposits, withdrawals, claims, mints, transfers, approvals.
msg.value is shared by every inner call; native deposits draw on it and leftover ETH stays claimable by anyone unless refundNativeToken is in the batch.
formats.shown: "Ve33 position batch" with each inner action decoded as calldata to this contract; the native value is not shown.

findings.title: multicall is payable and funds native deposits with msg.value, but no @.value field exists
findings.evidence: PayableMulticallable.multicall: `function multicall(bytes[] calldata data) public payable`; handleLockData pays native amount0 from contract balance. The format has only the `data.[]` calldata field.
findings.fix: Add a field {"path":"@.value","label":"Native value sent","format":"amount"}, and pass it as amountPath to the calldata field.

findings.title: multicall intent says nothing about what the batch does
findings.evidence: Descriptor: `"intent": "Batch Ve33 position actions"`, `"interpolatedIntent": "Ve33 position batch"`.
findings.fix: Keep the inner calldata fields visible; no better fixed sentence exists. Consider "Run several Ve33 position actions".
